title: 第15章 夤夜聆秘
content_zh:
他悄立半晌，想起十五年前在甘凉道上与温文新的父亲温宏伟动手，让他砍了一刀、劈了一掌，养了三年伤方康复，自知与他功夫相差太远，此仇难报，甘凉道一路从此绝足不走。此时温宏伟已死，温老太于己有恩，昔日的小小嫌隙早已不放在心上，哪知今日中夜又见仇人的遗孀孤儿各使八卦刀法对招。

    他思潮起伏：“温老太的武功实不在我之下，何以她竟然半点不露痕迹？她留我们是否另有别情？”凝思片刻，再凑眼到窗缝中时，见母子二人刀法已变，各使八卦游身刀法，满室游走，刀中夹掌，掌中夹刀，越打越快，打到第六十四招收势，二人向后跃开，母子俩依足了规矩，各自举刀致敬，这才垂下刀来。温老太不动声色，在青灯之下脸泛绿光。温文新却已满脸通红，呼呼喘气。

    温老太沉着脸说：“你的呼吸总是难以调匀，进境这样慢，猴年马月才报得了你爸爸的大仇？”岳胜心中一凛，只见温文新低下了头，甚有愧色。温老太继续说：“秦英豪的武功你虽没见到，他驭马控车的内力总亲眼目睹的了。闵恩仇的功夫不在秦英豪之下。你此刻跟这二贼的武功天差地远，但只要勤学苦练，每过一日，你武功长一分，这二贼却衰老了一分，终有一日，要将二贼在紫金刀下碎尸万段。”

    岳胜心想：“这母子二人闭门习武，不知闵恩仇早于十多年前便死了。”只听温老太叹了口长气说：“唉，你这孩子，我瞧你啊，这几日为岳家那丫头神魂颠倒，连练功夫也不起劲了。”

    岳胜一惊：“难道青青和他有了什么苟且之事？”但见温文新满脸通红，辩解说：“妈，我见了岳……岳姑娘总是规规矩矩的，话也没跟她多说几句。”温老太哼了声说：“你吃谁的奶长大？心里打什么主意，难道我还不明白？你看中岳姑娘，那不错，她人品武艺，我很合意。”温文新很高兴，叫了声：“妈！”温老太左手一挥，沉着嗓子问：“你可知他爸爸是谁？”温文新一愕问：“难道不是岳伯伯？”温老太说：“谁说不是？你却可知岳胜跟咱家有甚牵连？”温文新摇摇头。温老太说：“孩子，他也是你爸爸的仇人！”温文新大出意料之外，不禁“啊”了一声。

    岳胜不由发抖，但听温老太继续说：“十四年前，你爸爸在甘凉道上跟岳胜动手。你爸爸英雄盖世，那姓岳的岂是他对手？你爸爸砍了他一刀、劈了他一掌，将他打得重伤。但那姓岳的亦非平庸之辈，你爸在这场比武中也受了内伤。他回家来，伤未平复，咱们的对头闵恩仇深夜赶上门来，将你爸害死。若非你爸跟那姓岳的事先有这场较量，嘿嘿，紫金刀客威震江湖，谅那闵恩仇怎能害得你爸？”她说到最后这几句话时语音惨淡，嗓子嘶哑，听来极为可怖。

    岳胜一生经过不少大风大浪，此时听来却也不寒而栗，心想：“闵恩仇何等功夫，温宏伟就算身上无伤，也难逃此劫。老婆子心伤丈夫惨死，竟迁怒于我。”

    只听温老太又说：“阴差阳错，岳老头竟会运货投来我家。这温家堡是你爸爸亲手所建造，怎容鼠辈在此放肆劫货？但你可知我留姓岳的父女在此，有何打算？”温文新声音发颤问：“妈……你……你要我为爸报仇？”温老太厉声说：“你不肯，是不是？你是看上了那姓岳的丫头，是不是？”

    温文新见母亲眼中如要喷出火来，退后了两步，不敢回答。

    温老太冷笑说：“很好。过几天我给你跟那姓岳的提亲，以你的家世品貌，谅他决无不允。”

    这几句话叫岳胜和温文新都大出意料之外。岳胜隔窗看到温老太脸上切齿痛恨的神气，微一琢磨，全身寒毛根根直竖，心想：“老太婆用心好不狠毒！她杀我尚不足以泄愤，要将我花朵般的闺女娶作媳妇，折磨得她求生不得求死不能。天可怜见，叫我今晚隔窗听她母子这番话，否则……我那苦命的青青……”

    温文新年轻识浅，却全不明白母亲这番深意，又欢喜又诧异，想到母亲肯为自己主持这门亲事，欢喜倒有九分，只剩下一分诧异。

    岳胜只怕再听下去给温老太发觉，凝神提气，悄悄走远，回到自己屋中时抹了额头一把冷汗，猛然想起：“那奔到后山的瘦小黑影却又是谁？”

    第二天午后，岳胜换了件新外套，命温文新请母亲出来，有几句话商量。温文新又惊又喜，心想：“难道妈妈这么快就已跟他提了亲？瞧他这副神气打扮，那可不同寻常。”请母亲来到后厅，和岳胜分宾主坐下，自己下首相陪。他望望母亲，又望望岳胜，一颗心砰砰直跳，但听岳胜道谢护货之德、东道之谊，温老太满口谦虚，只盼他二人说到正题，但两个言来语去，尽是客套。

    说了好一会，岳胜才说：“小女年纪也不小了，我想跟老太太商量一件事。”温文新心砰的一下大跳。温老太大是奇怪：“却也没听说女家先开口来求亲的。”说道：“岳老板尽说不妨，咱们自己人，还拘什么礼数？”岳胜说：“我除了这丫头，膝下还有个养子。他天资愚钝，性子又鲁莽，但我从小就当他亲儿子一般看待。这孩子跟青青也挺合得来，我就想在宝地给他二人订了这桩亲事。”

    温文新越听越不对，听到最后一句话时，不自禁站起。温老太心头大怒：“这老头好生厉害，定是我那不中用的儿子露了破绽。”脸上不动声色，连声恭喜，又说：“孩儿，快给岳伯伯道喜！”温文新脑中糊涂一片，呆了一呆，直奔出外。

    岳胜又和温老太客气好一阵子，才回屋中，将儿女叫来，说今日要给二人订亲。周银兵大喜过望，笑得合不拢嘴来，岳青红晕双颊，转过了头不作声。岳胜说：“咱们在这儿先订了亲。至于亲事嘛，那是得回自个家去办的了。”他知儿女心中藏不住事，昨晚所闻所见半句不提。

    岳青娇憨活泼，明艳动人，在温家堡这么八个月一住，温文新和她日日相见，竟叫他一缕情丝牢牢缚在这位姑娘身上。他刚得母亲答允要给自己提亲，料想事无不谐，虽听母亲说与岳家有仇，但想大仇人毕竟是闵恩仇与秦英豪，岳家之仇自己从中调处，日久之后必能化解，正在满怀喜悦之际，突然听到了岳胜那几句晴天霹雳一般的言语。他独自坐在房中，从窗中望出去，呆呆瞧着院子中一株银杏，真难相信适才听到的话竟会是岳胜口中说出来的。

    他失魂落魄，也不知过了多少时候，直至一名佣工进房来，说道：“少堡主，练武的时候到啦，老太太等了你半天呢。”温文新一惊，暗叫：“糟糕，糊里糊涂地误了练武时候，少不得一顿好骂。”从壁上摘下了镖旗，快步奔到练武厅中。

    只见温老太坐在椅中，神色如常说：“今儿练督脉背心各穴。”转头向两名持牌的佣工叫道：“将牌儿拿稳了，走动！”温文新暗暗纳罕：“岳伯伯说这等话，怎么妈毫不在乎？”但温老太平日训子极严，练武之际尤其没半点宽纵，稍一不慎打骂随至，温文新取金钱镖扣在手里，不敢胡思乱想，凝神听着母亲叫穴。

    只听温老太叫道：“秦英豪，‘命门’、‘陶道’！”温文新右手双镖飞出，正中木牌上所绘人形背心两穴。温老太又叫：“闵恩仇，‘大椎’、‘阳关’！”温文新左手扬起，认明穴道，噔噔两声发出，“大椎穴”打准了，“阳关穴”却稍偏了些。

    突然见到木牌有异，一声惊噫脱口而出，定睛看时，见木牌上原来写着的“闵恩仇”三个黑字已然不见。他招手叫那持牌佣工过来，待那木牌拿近，看清楚“闵恩仇”三字已给人用利器刮去，却用刀尖刻了歪歪斜斜的“温宏伟”三字。这一来适才这两镖不是打了仇人，却是打中了自己父亲。温文新又急又怒，反手一掌，将那佣工打落两枚牙齿，跟着飞起一脚将他踢倒。

    温老太叫道：“且住！”心想这些佣工自幼在温家堡长大，怎能如此大胆？此事定是外人所为，心念一动，立时想到了岳胜三人，说道：“请岳老板他们三个来说话。”温文新本来为人精细，今日婚事不成，失意之下鲁莽出手，听母亲叫请岳胜，立知打错了人，忙将那佣工拉起，说道：“打错了你，别见怪。”伸手去拔牌上人形穴道中的金钱镖。温老太伸手拦住，说道：“慢着！就让他得意一下，又有何妨。”转头吩咐到老堡主灵堂取紫金刀来。

    岳胜三人走进厅来，见练武厅上人人神色有异。岳胜暗暗吃惊：“这老婆子好厉害，一时三刻便即翻脸。”双手一拱问：“老太太呼唤，不知何事？”温老太冷笑说：“先夫已然逝世，岳老板往日虽有过节，却也不该拿死人来出气啊。”岳胜一呆，笑着说：“在下愚鲁，请老太太明示。”温老太向那木牌上一指说：“岳老板乃是江湖上响当当的汉子，这般卑鄙行径，想来也不屑为。请问是令爱所干的呢，还是贵公子的手笔？”说着双目闪闪生光，向岳家三人脸上来回扫视。岳青从未见过她如此凛然有威，甚为惊诧。

    岳胜见木牌上改了人名，也大为骇异，朗声说：“小女与犬子虽然蠢笨，但绝不敢如此胡闹。”温老太大声说：“那么依岳老板之见，是温家堡自己人干的勾当了？”岳胜想起昨晚所见的那瘦小人形，说道：“只怕是外人摸进堡来，也是有的。在下昨晚……”温老太打断话头，厉声喝道：“难道会是闵恩仇那狗贼自己来做这鬼祟的勾当？”一言甫毕，突然人圈外一人接着叫道：“不敢去找真人动手，却将人家名字写在牌上出气。这才是卑鄙行径，鬼祟勾当！”

    温老太坐在椅上，瞧不见说话之人是谁，但听到他声音尖细，叫道：“是谁说话？你过来！”只见两名佣工给人推着向两旁一分，一个男孩走上前来，正是闵嘉庚。
content_en:
He stood quietly for a long time, remembering that fifteen years ago, he fought with Wen Wenxin's father, Wen Hongwei, on the Ganliang Road. He had him chop and split his hand, and it took him three years to recover from the injury. At this time, Wen Hongwei was dead, and Mrs. Wen was kind to her, and she no longer cared about the petty quarrels in the past. Who would have thought that today, in the middle of the night, she would see the enemy's widow and orphan again, each using Bagua sword skills to fight against each other.

    His thoughts fluctuated: "Old Mrs. Wen's martial arts skills are not inferior to mine. Why didn't she show any trace? Does she have any other reason for leaving us?" After thinking for a moment, he looked through the crack of the window and saw that the swordsmanship of the mother and son had changed. Each of them used the Bagua sword technique to roam around the room, holding the knife in the palm, holding the knife in the palm, and struck faster and faster. When the sixty-fourth strike was reached, the two jumped back. The mother and son followed the rules, each raised the sword in salute, and then lowered the sword. Mrs. Wen remained calm, her face glowing green under the green light. Wen Wenxin's face was flushed and he was panting.

    Mrs. Wen said with a sullen face, "It's always hard to breathe evenly, and it's so slow to enter the country. How can it take you years and years to avenge your father?" Yue Sheng's heart trembled, and Wen Wenxin lowered his head, feeling very ashamed. Mrs. Wen continued: "Although you haven't seen Qin Yinghao's martial arts, you have witnessed his internal strength in controlling horses and chariots. Min Enchou's martial arts are not inferior to Qin Yinghao's. Your martial arts are far different from those of these two thieves at the moment, but as long as you study hard and practice hard, every day your martial arts will improve by one point, the two thieves will age by one point. One day, the two thieves will be cut into pieces under the purple gold knife."

    Yue Sheng thought to himself: "The mother and son are practicing martial arts behind closed doors. I don't know that Min Enchou died more than ten years ago." Old Mrs. Wen sighed and said, "Oh, you kid, look at you. These days, you are obsessed with that girl from the Yue family. You don't even have the energy to practice kung fu."

    Yue Sheng was startled: "Did Qingqing have something to do with him?" But Wen Wenxin's face turned red and he defended: "Mom, when I met Yue... Miss Yue always behaved herself and didn't say a few words to her." Mrs. Wen snorted and said, "Whose milk did you grow up on? What's your plan in mind? Don't I understand? You fancy Miss Yue. , That's good, her character and martial arts are very satisfactory to me." Wen Wenxin was very happy and called out: "Mom!" Mrs. Wen waved her left hand and asked in a deep voice: "Do you know who his father is?" Wen Wenxin asked in surprise, "Isn't it Uncle Yue?" Mrs. Wen said, "Who said not? Do you know that Yue Sheng is related to our family?" Old Mrs. Wen said, "Child, he is also your father's enemy!" Wen Wenxin was so surprised that he couldn't help but let out an "Ah" sound.

    Yue Sheng could not help but tremble, but he heard Mrs. Wen continue to say: "Fourteen years ago, your father fought with Yue Sheng on the Ganliang Road. Your father was a hero, so how could the man named Yue be his opponent? Your father slashed him with a knife, split his palm, and severely injured him. But the man named Yue was not an ordinary person, and your father also suffered internal injuries in this competition. . When he came home, his injuries were not healed, and our enemy Min Enchou came to the door late at night and killed your father. If your father and the man named Yue hadn't had this fight beforehand, hehe, the Purple Gold Swordsman is so powerful, how could Min Enchou hurt your father?" When she said these last few words, her voice was hoarse, and it sounded extremely terrifying.

    Yue Sheng experienced many storms and waves in his life, but he shuddered when he heard this. He thought to himself: "Min Enqiu is so hard, even if Wen Hongwei is not injured, he will not be able to escape this disaster. This old woman is heartbroken that her husband died tragically, so she turned her anger on me."

    Only to hear Old Mrs. Wen say again: "By some strange combination of circumstances, Old Yue actually shipped goods to my house. Your father built this Wenjia Fort with his own hands. How could you allow rats to rob goods here? But did you know that my father and daughter named Yue are here?" "What are your plans?" Wen Wenxin asked with a trembling voice: "Mom...you...you want me to avenge my father?" Mrs. Wen said sharply: "You don't want to, right? You have a crush on the girl named Yue, right?"

    Seeing that his mother's eyes were about to burst into flames, Wen Wenxin took two steps back and did not dare to answer.

    Mrs. Wen sneered and said, "Very good. In a few days, I will propose marriage to that man named Yue. Given your family background and appearance, I will forgive him for not refusing."

    These few words surprised both Yue Sheng and Wen Wenxin. Yue Sheng saw the look of hatred on Old Mrs. Wen's face through the window. He thought about it for a moment, and the hairs all over his body stood up, thinking: "How cruel is the old woman's intention? Killing me is not enough to vent her anger. She wants to marry my flower-like daughter as her daughter-in-law, and tortures her to the point of begging for life and death. For mercy's sake, let me listen to her mother and son's words through the window tonight, otherwise...my miserable Qingqing..."

    Wen Wenxin, a young man with little knowledge, did not understand the profound meaning of his mother's words. He was happy and surprised at the same time. Thinking that his mother was willing to host this marriage for him, he was 90% happy and only 100% surprised.

    Yue Sheng was afraid that Mrs. Wen would find out if he continued to listen, so he concentrated his energy and quietly walked away. When he returned to his room, he wiped a cold sweat from his forehead and suddenly remembered: "Who is that thin black figure running to the back hill?"

    In the afternoon of the next day, Yue Sheng put on a new coat and ordered Wen Wenxin to invite his mother out for a few words of discussion. Wen Wenxin was surprised and happy, thinking: "Did mother propose to him so soon? Look at the way he looks and behaves, that's unusual." He asked his mother to come to the back hall, where he sat down with Yue Sheng as guest and host, and he got down to accompany her. He looked at his mother and then at Yue Sheng, his heart pounding. But when he heard Yue Sheng express his gratitude for his kindness in protecting goods and his friendship with his host, Mrs. Wen was full of humility and hoped that they would get to the point, but their words were all polite.

    After talking for a while, Yue Sheng said: "My daughter is not young anymore. I want to discuss something with the old lady." Wen Wenxin's heart skipped a beat. Mrs. Wen was surprised: "But I haven't heard that the girl asked for marriage first." She said, "Boss Yue said it's okay, we are our own people, why should we follow the etiquette?" Yue Sheng said: "In addition to this girl, I also have an adopted son. He is stupid in nature and has a reckless temper, but I have treated him as my own son since he was a child. This child and Qingqing also get along well, so I want to arrange this marriage for the two of them in Baodi."

    The more Wen Wenxin listened, the more wrong he became. When he heard the last sentence, he couldn't help but stand up. Old Mrs. Wen was furious: "This old man is so powerful, my worthless son must have exposed his flaws." With a calm face, she congratulated her repeatedly, and then said, "My child, please say congratulations to Uncle Yue!" Wen Wenxin's mind was confused, he was stunned for a moment, and went straight out.

    Yue Sheng was polite to Mrs. Wen for a while, then returned to the house, called his children, and said that they would be engaged today. Zhou Yinbing was overjoyed and smiled from ear to ear. Yue Qing's cheeks turned red and he turned his head and remained silent. Yue Sheng said: "Let's get engaged here first. As for the marriage, we have to go back to our own homes to do it." He knew that his children couldn't hide things in their minds, so he didn't mention anything about what they heard and saw last night.

    Yue Qingjiao was lively, lively, and charming. After living in Wenjiabao for eight months, Wen Wenxin saw her every day, and his love for this girl was firmly bound to him. He had just received his mother's consent to propose marriage to him, and he expected that everything would be in harmony. Although he heard from his mother that she had a grudge against the Yue family, he thought that the biggest enemies were Min Enchou and Qin Yinghao after all. He sat alone in his room, looking out the window and staring blankly at a ginkgo tree in the yard. It was hard to believe that the words he just heard came from Yue Sheng's mouth.

    He was in a daze, and he didn't know how much time had passed until a servant came into the room and said, "Young Master, it's time for martial arts practice. The old lady has been waiting for you for a long time." Wen Wenxin was shocked and secretly shouted: "Oops, I missed the time for martial arts practice by mistake, so I need to get scolded." He took off the escort flag from the wall and hurried to the martial arts training hall.

    I saw Old Mrs. Wen sitting in the chair, looking as usual and saying: "Today I will practice the various points on the Du Vein vest." She turned to the two servants holding the cards and shouted: "Hold the cards firmly and move around!" Wen Wenxin secretly wondered: "Uncle Yue said such things "Why doesn't Mom care?" But Mrs. Wen was very strict in her training, and she was especially unforgiving when practicing martial arts. She would be beaten and scolded if she accidentally hit him. Wen Wenxin took the money dart and clasped it in his hand, not daring to think wildly, and listened intently to his mother's screams.

    Just listen to Mrs. Wen shouting: "Qin Yinghao, 'Ming Men', 'Tao Dao'!" Wen Wenxin's right hand flew out with two darts, hitting the two points on the human-shaped vest painted on the wooden sign. Mrs. Wen called again: "Min Enchou, 'Dazhui' and 'Yangguan'!" Wen Wenxin raised his left hand to identify the acupoints, and made two thumping sounds. The "Dazhui acupoint" was hit correctly, but the "Yangguan acupoint" was slightly off.

    Suddenly I saw something strange on the wooden sign, and I blurted out a cry of surprise. When I looked at it carefully, I saw that the three black characters "Min Enchou" originally written on the wooden sign were gone. He waved the licensed servant over. When he brought the wooden sign closer, he saw clearly that the characters "Min Enchou" had been scraped off with a sharp tool, but the characters "Wen Hongwei" were carved crookedly with the sharp edge of a knife. As a result, the two darts just now did not hit their enemies, but their own father. Wen Wenxin was anxious and angry. He knocked out two of the servant's teeth with his backhand, then kicked him down with a flying kick.

    Old Mrs. Wen shouted: "Stay here!" She thought to herself that these servants had grown up in Wenjiapu, how could they be so bold? This matter must have been done by an outsider. When he thought about it, he immediately thought of Yue Sheng and the others and said, "Please let Boss Yue and the others speak." Wen Wenxin was originally a delicate person, but his marriage was not going to happen today. He was frustrated and took action rashly. When his mother called Yue Sheng, he immediately knew that he had hit the wrong person. He quickly pulled the servant up and said, "I hit you by mistake. Don't be surprised." He reached out to pull out the money dart from the human-shaped acupuncture point on the card. Mrs. Wen stretched out her hand to stop him and said, "Wait a minute! What's the harm in just letting him be proud of himself." She turned around and ordered to go to the main mourning hall of the old castle to get the purple gold knife.

    Yue Sheng and the others walked into the hall and saw that everyone in the martial arts training hall had different expressions. Yue Sheng was secretly surprised: "This old woman is so powerful, she can fall out of favor at any moment." He raised his hands and asked, "What's the matter with the old lady calling me?" Mrs. Wen sneered and said, "My late husband has passed away. Although Boss Yue had some festivals in the past, he shouldn't vent his anger on dead people." Yue Sheng was stunned and said with a smile: "In I'm stupid, please tell me." Mrs. Wen pointed at the wooden sign and said, "Boss Yue is a well-known man in the world, and he would not even think about doing such a despicable act. Is it your wife's fault, or is it the work of your master?" As she spoke, her eyes flashed and she glanced back and forth at the faces of the three Yue family members. Yue Qing had never seen her so majestic and majestic, and was very surprised.

    Yue Sheng was shocked when he saw that the name of the person had been changed on the wooden sign, and said loudly: "Although the little girl and the dog are stupid, they would never dare to act like this." Mrs. Wen said loudly: "Then in Boss Yue's opinion, it was Wenjiabao's own people who did it?" Yue Sheng thought of the thin humanoid he saw last night and said, "I'm afraid it was an outsider who broke into the fort. Yes. Last night..." Mrs. Wen interrupted and shouted: "Could it be that thief Min Enchou who did this sneaky thing?" After saying this, someone outside the circle suddenly shouted: "You don't dare to go to the real person to vent your anger on someone else's name. This is a despicable act!"

    Old Mrs. Wen was sitting on the chair and couldn't see who was speaking, but she heard his shrill voice shouting: "Who is speaking? Come here!" She saw two helpers pushing them to the sides, and a boy came forward, it was Min Jiageng.
